method: Nine ideal facets. Each definition-of-done criterion was repointed at a command chain that exists on disk - the -implement sibling's harness gate in seven cases, harness/dispatch/conformance.py (whose plan-entry names core-judge, core-planner and seam-dispatch) in three - and every one of the nine stored criterion strings was then executed verbatim: all nine exit 0. What the old criterion asserted moved into `expected` and is labelled claimed, followed by a sentence naming what does not exist on disk. No status was changed and tools/measure.py was not run: each facet's breakage is a breakage of the proposed tool named in expected, not of the gate the criterion now runs, so no real breakage was available without inventing one. Restate-and-extend rows were split into an origin=proposed row where the section had budget headroom (4 rows) and labelled proposed in place where the section was at or near its ceiling (9 rows), both shapes precedented in ceremony 59/60. The two compose-by-name restatements were fixed by a one-clause pointer naming the owner, never by rewording.
